newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end higher for first time this week.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end higher for first time this week.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks rebounded Friday, their first up session this week, but the broader market ended mixed as investors awaited a slew of economic reports due next week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 14.54 points to end at 6,007.02, after falling 44 points on Thursday. In the broader market, declining and advancing issues were about even on moderate volume of about 367 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
